ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: if the message is part of the B-file, according to the mapping rules.
ambiguity_resolubility.supported_interpretation: The system checks if the received message matches any entry in the B-file based on a predefined set of mapping rules (e.g., exact match, substring match).

evidence_from_context: Glossary: 'mapping rules: A static lookup table, versioned quarterly, that maps incoming message type codes to B-file classification categories.' This definition implies a fixed and explicit rule set for matching messages to B-files.
